product_name: Creating a social media strategy for your education brand

product_name: AI Playbook for School Marketing, Admissions and Commercial

target_buyer: Education marketing and communications professionals

what_is_included: Six video modules, workbook per module, pre-populated or mapped marketing plan, weekly live check-in, CPD certificate. Modules cover messaging, website and social, trust-building, digital and offline promotion, and conversion events.
tangible_outputs: Marketing plan and completed workbook tasks.
assessment_or_certificate: Certificate of completion described as recognised CPD
coaching_included: Weekly live check-in for questions. Not described as a private coaching series.

free_trial_or_free_entry: Free health check is a separate lead product.
next_obvious_paid_step: Strategic marketing plan over three months.
upsell_or_cross_sell: Admissions course; strategic marketing plan; consultancy
evidence_notes: Only published price found. The page is titled January sale and does not show a higher crossed-out list price. The main course page does not state a fee. Currency of the sale title versus a standing price is unresolved.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Three-month strategic marketing plan or done-with-you consultancy.

target_buyer: Admissions and marketing staff. Up to two people per booking.

price_ex_vat: £1,996 + VAT per course for up to 2 team members

target_buyer: School leaders and marketing leads
problem_solved: Need a bespoke plan rather than a standard course.

tangible_outputs: Bespoke strategic marketing plan.
report_description: Strategic marketing plan. Contents beyond the name are NOT PUBLISHED.
implementation_support: Co-created over three months. Done-for-you execution NOT PUBLISHED.
free_trial_or_free_entry: Free health check can precede it.
next_obvious_paid_step: Ongoing support. Scope NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Duration and output are published. Price is not.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Retained support or the online courses for the wider team.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The three-month plan is the premium sibling of a £2k course, and its price is hidden. That is the band a commercial-growth diagnostic has to sit in or explain.

product_name: Free marketing and admissions health check

problem_solved: No quick view of strengths and weaknesses before buying help.

next_obvious_paid_step: Online course or strategic marketing plan, via a 20-minute call.

target_buyer: Staff new to school marketing, communications or income generation
target_sector: Schools and MATs, including primary, secondary and special schools
problem_solved: No foundation course the office can finish around the day job.
duration: 12 months access. About 4 hours of self-study stated on the course page.
price_inc_vat_if_relevant: £180 on the Education Conferences UK checkout
what_is_included: Six modules, parallel workbook, editable templates, quizzes. Booking is via Education Conferences UK.

target_buyer: School business leaders, heads, office teams, MAT staff, governors

target_buyer: Individual schools, small MATs, regional school-business groups
problem_solved: The team needs a longer, private bid-writing session rather than a half-day open course.
format: In-school day or three live online modules
duration: 1 day in school, or 3 online modules
price_ex_vat: In-school individual school or small MAT £950 + VAT. Regional group or MAT £1,250 + VAT. Online three modules £950 + VAT.
group_price: In-school small team minimum 2 and maximum 5 at £950 + VAT. Regional or MAT minimum 5 and maximum 25 at £1,250 + VAT. Online minimum 2 and maximum 25 at £950 + VAT. Venue and refreshments provided by the school for in-person.
what_is_included: Face-to-face day or three live webinars. Detailed agenda NOT PUBLISHED on the price block.
tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED
toolkit_or_templates: Training pages say practical templates in the bid-writing range. This page's inclusion list is thin.
next_obvious_paid_step: Done-for-you bid writing. Fees agreed per project and NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Two delivery modes and two in-person group bands are published. They are tiers of one masterclass, so they share a row.
